senses.gloss: f. (זגג, v. זַגָּג) glass, crystal; glass-ware.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 28:18">Targ. Job XXVIII, 18</cite> (in one version); a. e. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) <he>בית זוג׳</he> glass house.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:2">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>כסי דזגוג׳</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <he>כסא דזוג׳ חיורתא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) cups (a cup) of (white) glass; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 881:1">Yalk. Ps. 881</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 84b:3">Ḥull. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>בזיגותא וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) it means white glass (crystal).

<cite ref="Gittin 68b:8">Gitt. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>זוג׳</he>. [<cite ref="Pesachim 74b">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>כזוּגָּא חיורא</he> Ar. a. Ms. O. like white glass; ed. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זוזא</he></cite>.]
